$comment: The 1378 start scenario (X-25), milestone 10. The regions' data lives in regions/<key>/; tools/domain-data/build-1378.py joins them into the files beside this one, and tools/mapgen/mapgen.ts 1378 builds world/ from those. New campaigns start here (step 7, the switch-over); the 1444 checkpoint runs behind ?start=1444 (PH_START=1444 in Node), read through packages/rules/src/start.ts. suggested: the realm picker's suggested realms, the great powers of each part of the world and one start per part of Africa (SETUP-074).
name: Autumn 1378

eras.$comment: Era I is stretched back to the start (X-25), so the start falls in Era I as in 1444.

files.regions/<key>/: each region's part, in the shapes of the 1444 folder (see regions/README.md); the source of every joined file
files.map-nations.json, map-owners.json, ruler: the regions joined in the order of regions (generated; fix the region and re-run build-1378.py); relations and subjects read a map id whose record has another id as that record (SETUP-049)
files.map-to-catalogue.json: map nations whose 1378 catalogue record has another id, over scenario-setup.json's map_to_catalogue (generated)
files.sleeping-realms.json, ports.json: sleeping realms and port towns by [lon, lat] or owner-rule selector (generated); mapgen places them in world/
files.world/: the generated map (map, nations, provinces, sleeping realms, ports, the build report, and from-1444.json mapping each 1444 province to this map's) built by tools/mapgen
